chapterTitle: Chapter 11 Reactions of Alkyl Halides: Nucleophilic Substitutions and Eliminations
title: Problem 11-1

pages.text: PROBLEM 11-1 What product would you expect from a nucleophilic substitution reaction of (S)-2-bromohexane with acetate ion, CH3CO2–? Assume that inversion of configuration occurs, and show the stereochemistry of both the reactant and product.
